newsitem.title: UK: Daiwa Bank says to close German subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Bank says to close German subsidiary.

text.p: Japan's Daiwa Bank said on Friday it would close its wholly-owned German subsidiary Daiwa Bank (Deutschland) GmbH as part of an on-going review of its overseas operations.
The bank said in a statement that the "liquidation process is scheduled to commence in March 1997".
Daiwa Bank said that as of October 11, it had six overseas branches, 10 sub-branches, seven representative offices and nine overseas subsidiaries remaining.
In November last year the bank said it would keep its German unit open, despite the closure of offices in several countries and the enforced shutting down of its U.S. operations.
This was as a result of a trader at its New York branch running up losses totalling $1.1 billion through unauthorised trades.
